behaviors.description: Per-callsite host state and state slots persist across thinks at one call site and survive page reactivation.
A cancelled handle throws Cancelled in the fiber awaiting it.
A rejected handle throws an error carrying the rejection's code in the fiber awaiting it.
A resolved handle carries its value to the fiber awaiting it.
A WHEN section suspends on an asynchronous sensor and resumes at the same point once the handle settles.
A bytecode-bound action -- a compiled tile -- dispatches through the program's action table and returns its result.
An asynchronously dispatched bytecode-bound action runs its body in a child fiber and yields a pending handle.
A rule nested in a parent's DO section spawns its own fire-and-forget fiber at the parent's tail.
Freshly spawned child rules drain depth-first within the spawning think, one subtree finishing before the next begins.
An async handle rejected without an explicit error faults the awaiting fiber with HostError.
A faulted fiber ends alone: the other fibers scheduled in the same think still run.
A dispatch-time exception raised by a host body faults the calling fiber with ScriptError.
Crossing a per-fiber or global capacity cap faults the offending fiber with StackOverflow.
THROW of a value that is not an error faults the fiber with ScriptError.
AWAIT parks the fiber on a pending handle and runs nothing of that fiber until the handle settles.
A fiber that spends its instruction budget mid-slice re-enqueues and resumes in the next round.
Deactivating, restarting, or switching away from a page cancels its root-rule fibers and every live child beneath them.
A tick snapshots the runnable queue and gives each fiber in it exactly one budget slice, in enqueue order.
YIELD suspends the fiber and re-enqueues it for the next round.
A dispatch re-executed without a free handle for the contracted number of starved rounds faults StackOverflow.
A fiber made runnable by a settling handle runs in the next round, never the round the handle settled in.
An asynchronous host-bound action dispatch yields a pending handle and pushes no value.
A synchronous host-bound action receives its positional arg buffer, with an unsupplied slot filled by nil, and pushes its result.
The value a synchronous host sensor returns reaches the WHEN gate of the rule that read it.
An implicit conversion fires at an assignment target, a struct field target, or a typed argument slot.
The list opcodes construct, read, write, and resize a list value.
The map opcodes construct, read, write, and delete entries of a map value.
Brain-observable numbers compute and render at the profile's precision, f32 or f64.
An action's initializer, activation, and deactivation hooks fire in their contracted order and lifetime.
A page change or restart request takes effect at the next think, after the current page deactivates.
A root rule does not re-fire while any live fiber of its rule subtree is still in flight.
A completed or faulted root-rule fiber respawns on the next think; a fault kills the fiber, not the rule.
A rule's WHEN evaluation records Evaluating, DidFire, or DidNotFire for the rules that read it.
An `otherwise` rule fires on a think when no earlier rule at its own level fired.
The chain gate variants of WHEN_END compute their own outcome and then write the chain value the `otherwise` subject lookup reads.
A `then` rule runs after its preceding sibling completes as a rule that fired.
A `then` whose subject's cluster lost a fiber to a fault or a cancellation resolves as a skip.
A rule with no WHEN section fires every think it is scheduled.
A WHEN section evaluating falsy skips the rule's DO section by the gate's offset.
A WHEN section evaluating truthy runs the rule's DO section in the same think.
The presence-gated WHEN boundary runs DO on any non-nil WHEN result and skips only on nil.
The struct opcodes construct a struct and read and write its fields by slot index.
TRY installs a handler that catches a throw raised beneath it and resumes execution at the handler.
LOAD_VAR_SLOT and STORE_VAR_SLOT read and write brain-global variable slots, with a slot holding no value reading as nil.
A WHEN boundary captures the value its section evaluated to into the rule's reserved __whenResult variable.
